mapper.sql: id, user_id, category, content, keywords, entity, entity_type, importance, confidence, dedup_key, access_count, last_accessed_at, source_conversation_id, source_turn, metadata, is_deleted, expired_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_long_term_memory ( user_id, category, content, keywords, entity, entity_type, embedding, importance, confidence, dedup_key, access_count, last_accessed_at, source_conversation_id, source_turn, metadata, is_deleted, expired_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{category}, #{content}, COALESCE(#{keywords, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.library.agent.handler.StringArrayTypeHandler}, '{}'::text[]), #{entity}, #{entityType}, #{embedding, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.library.agent.handler.FloatArrayTypeHandler}, COALESCE(#{importance}, 5), COALESCE(#{confidence}, 0.8), #{dedupKey}, COALESCE(#{accessCount}, 0), #{lastAccessedAt}, #{sourceConversationId}, #{sourceTurn}, COALESCE(#{metadata, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.library.agent.handler.JsonbTypeHandler}, '{}'::jsonb), COALESCE(#{deleted}, FALSE), #{expiredAt}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.select: SELECT , embedding FROM agent_long_term_memory WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = FALSE
SELECT , embedding FROM agent_long_term_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND dedup_key = #{dedupKey} AND is_deleted = FALSE LIMIT 1

SELECT
FROM agent_long_term_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = FALSE AND (expired_at IS NULL OR expired_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND category IN ('USER_PROFILE', 'PREFERENCE', 'CONSTRAINT') ORDER BY importance DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT , embedding, 1 - (embedding <=> #{queryEmbedding, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.library.agent.handler.FloatArrayTypeHandler}) AS similarity FROM agent_long_term_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = FALSE AND embedding IS NOT NULL AND (expired_at IS NULL OR expired_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND category = 'EXPERIENCE' ORDER BY embedding <=> #{queryEmbedding, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.library.agent.handler.FloatArrayTypeHandler}, id LIMIT #{topK}

SELECT , embedding, 1 - (embedding <=> #{queryEmbedding, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.library.agent.handler.FloatArrayTypeHandler}) AS similarity FROM agent_long_term_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = FALSE AND embedding IS NOT NULL AND (expired_at IS NULL OR expired_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY embedding <=> #{queryEmbedding, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.library.agent.handler.FloatArrayTypeHandler}, id LIMIT #{topK}
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_long_term_memory SET access_count = access_count + 1, last_accessed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND id = #{id} AND is_deleted = FALSE

UPDATE agent_long_term_memory SET category = #{category}, content = #{content}, keywords = COALESCE(#{keywords, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.library.agent.handler.StringArrayTypeHandler}, '{}'::text[]), entity = #{entity}, entity_type = #{entityType}, embedding = #{embedding, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.library.agent.handler.FloatArrayTypeHandler}, importance = COALESCE(#{importance}, importance), confidence = COALESCE(#{confidence}, confidence), metadata = COALESCE(#{metadata, jdbcType=OTHER, typeHandler=com.library.agent.handler.JsonbTypeHandler}, metadata), expired_at = #{expiredAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = FALSE
UPDATE agent_long_term_memory SET is_deleted = TRUE, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = FALSE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM agent_long_term_memory WHERE is_deleted = TRUE OR (expired_at IS NOT NULL AND expired_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, category FROM agent_long_term_memory WHERE is_deleted = FALSE GROUP BY user_id, category
